name: Hearts of Palm
siboNotes: Hearts of palm are naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated on SIBO diets. Their mild flavor and tender texture make them easy to digest.
preparationTips: Rinse canned hearts of palm before using to reduce sodium content
Slice lengthwise for salads or crosswise for stir-fries
Can be eaten raw or lightly cooked - avoid overcooking as they become mushy
Pat dry after rinsing if using in salads to prevent diluting dressings
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of potassium for heart health
Provides dietary fiber for digestive health
